## Story

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

Deep in the park, there is a green tree. The tree is big and old. A frog named Fern lives by the tree. She sits on a log next to the trunk.

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

### Spelling Aid

**Phonograms on this page:** a, b, d, e, f

**Rules in this story:**

**Rule 8:** I and O may say /ī/ /ō/ before two consonants

**Rule 21:** Plural nouns

</div>

</div>

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

"It is good here," says Fern. "The tree keeps me cool."

Up in the tree top, a bird has a nest. The nest has three small eggs. The bird sings all day long.

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

### Spelling Aid

**Phonograms on this page:** a, b, c, d, e

**Rules in this story:**

**Rule 3:** No English word ends in I, U, V, or J

**Rule 9:** AY for /ā/ at end

**Rule 22:** 3rd person singular verbs

</div>

</div>

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

Then — strong wind! The wind shakes the tree. The nest slips! "Help!" sings the bird.

</div>

</div>

<div class="reader-sidebar">

## Think About It

1. Who lives in the green tree? (A bird with three eggs.) 2. What happens when the wind comes? (The nest falls.) 3. How does Fern help? (She catches the nest.) 4. Find an EE word in the story. (tree, green, see, keep, deep, three, seed)
